name: @workspace/desktop
description: Nacho macOS desktop shell (Electron). Local-only build — not part of the Replit web deploy.

scripts.build:renderer: BASE_PATH=/ PORT=5173 pnpm --filter @workspace/nacho run build && node ./scripts/copy-renderer.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main
scripts.pack:local: pnpm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --config.mac.hardenedRuntime=false --config.mac.identity=null && node ./scripts/sign-local.mjs
